pages.title: Mystical Reinforcements
pages.text: Because Zephyr Haulers rely on specialized structural components rather than standard tool durability, they reject almost all traditional magic.$(br)$(br)However, you $(2)can$() enchant them with $(2)Unbreaking (I - III)$() using an Enchanting Table or Anvil.

pages.title: Unbreaking Synergy
pages.text: Unbreaking grants a high chance to completely ignore durability damage during a flight or a rough landing.$(br)$(br)When combined with $(2)Netherite Plating$(), an $(2)Unbreaking III$() balloon can average over $(2)120 MAX Integrity() before needing a Maintenance Station.
